**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, T4C).**

- **Issue:** The Agreement runs on an evergreen term (§ 2 — continues "until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6"), but the only convenience right (§ 6(a)) applies solely "at any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding." Once an SOW is live, our only exit is material breach under § 6(b). That gives us no convenience right during any engagement of a term effectively longer than 12 months, failing even the fallback position.
- **Vendor side is fine:** The 15-day mutual right is symmetrically gated on there being no outstanding SOW, so RadialSpark cannot walk away mid-engagement. No redline needed there — flagging it would be picking at a term that already protects us.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New § 6(c) giving Clear Capital a 30-day convenience right over the Agreement or any SOW, without penalty, with Contractor paid for Services performed through termination and refunding prepaid, unearned fees — matching the preferred position and seed-t4c precedent, with 60 days offered as a fallback.
